text: In the first method, FeCl3·6H2O (270.3 mg, 1 mmol), Na3C6H5O7·2H2O (882.3 mg, 3 mmol), and urea (360.4 mg, 6 mmol) were accurately weighed into a 100 mL round-bottom flask. Ultrapure water (40 mL) was added, and the mixture was stirred magnetically at 1000 rpm for 2 min to obtain a clear, bright yellow solution.

source.title: Novel Magnetic Covalent Organic Frameworks Fabricated Through In Situ Synthesis and Assembly for the Efficient Extraction and Enrichment of Six Amide Herbicides
